item.title: Dubois County Poll Shows Overwhelming Opposition to Proposed Mid-States Corridor Project
item.description: A public interest poll released in Dubois County shows strong local opposition to the proposed Mid-States Corridor project that would connect I-64 to I-69. According to 14News, 81% of respondents oppose the project, with 72% strongly opposed.
